shared_schema.input: synthetic=true, residency EU|US, subscribers[], tickets[], usage_csv, feedback[]. All entity records carry id and matching residency. Strict fields; opaque identifiers use sub/tkt/cdr/fb plus underscore and 3-12 digits.
shared_schema.subscriber: id, residency, phone (reserved fictitious range), imei (SYNTHETIC-IMEI marker), name, email (example.invalid), processing_basis consent|legitimate_interest, analytics_allowed=true
shared_schema.ticket: id, residency, subscriber_id, fault network|billing|support|usage; optional billing_adjustment with finite amount and nonblank reason
shared_schema.usage_csv: Exact header: id,residency,subscriber_id,ticket_id,call_seconds,data_mb. Nonnegative finite usage values, consistent account/ticket foreign keys.
shared_schema.feedback: id, residency, subscriber_id, ticket_id, channel=support_chat, text (1-10000 characters). Text contains synthetic support chat transcript.
shared_schema.output: status, synthetic, residency, summary counts, themes[] containing residency, count and evidence[]. Evidence carries residency, subscriber_id, ticket_id, source_feedback_ids, usage_record_ids and redacted excerpt.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function gates all input entities and the published output; CLI errors return one generic JSON object and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: validated entities -> redacted normalized transcripts -> within-account/ticket deduplication -> deterministic keyword themes -> traceable evidence -> validated JSON result

behavior.deduplication: Whitespace and case normalization after redaction; only within the same subscriber and ticket. Every duplicate source ID is preserved.
behavior.themes: Fixed word-boundary rules: billing, connectivity, support, usage; unmatched transcripts use other. Multiple themes permitted; counts represent unique feedback, not total mentions.
behavior.excerpts: First 240 characters after redaction. Theme detection uses complete redacted text. Input order determines retained excerpt case; output and ID lists sorted deterministically.
behavior.privacy: Data minimization and opt-out/processing-basis validation illustrate GDPR/CCPA subscriber-data protections. Known names, phones, emails and IMEIs are redacted; generic email and numeric contact patterns also redacted. No raw transcript output or logging. Opaque subscriber references are pseudonymous, not anonymous.
behavior.residency: Every input entity and output theme/evidence record must carry the selected region tag. Local-only processing; tags are demonstrative, not physical hosting attestation.
behavior.fixtures: Explicit synthetic envelope, reserved phone numbers, labeled fake IMEI, invented tickets. Usage volumes are synthetic; tests additionally generate seeded randomized volumes.
behavior.llm: No LLM or provider required or implemented.

included: Synthetic subscriber privacy and residency rules

test_outcomes.cli_error_cases: Missing file, missing/extra arguments, invalid JSON and wrong schema return error JSON and exit 2.
